etsy.title: Git Commit Sticker, Friday 4:59 PM wip Joke, Funny Programmer Laptop Decal, Developer Gift
etsy.description:
A git commit sticker for the last commit of the week: git commit -m "wip", Friday, 4:59 PM.

WHAT YOU'LL GET
• One physical kiss-cut vinyl sticker, shipped directly to you
• Available in 3×3 in and 4×4 in
• Glossy finish, with a backing that peels away cleanly

HOW TO USE
Peel and stick on a laptop, notebook, or monitor stand. Made for indoor use, so keep it dry.

This listing is a physical sticker, not a digital download. Thank you for supporting a small shop!
